payload.text: which --json's code (ST0002/WP03) waits for cc's sign-off of the shape ic sent. vc said yes with three changes: (a) rank null for unknown accounts; (b) resets_at as the endpoint gives it, to the second, the minute rounding kept inside the rule; (c) headroom under --model as cc defines it (vc suggested weekly terms). Released when cc has signed; then ic sends vc the final shape, which vc gives geodica-estate.
